label: Neutral
note: Early fear (day 4 of stress, VIX high 35.9): Fear has just begun and the VIX is near its high. Average returns after such days have been normal, but they were followed by the deepest drops: not the bottom, a high-risk entry. Variance risk premium (HAR) higher than 98% of the last 10 years. VIX above VIX3M: the term structure is inverted, a sign of near-term stress.
method: Fear score = 0.3 × (3 + 4 × HAR variance-risk-premium percentile over 10 years) + 0.7 × fear-phase score (calm 5, early fear 5 + risk flag, peak stress 5.5, fading fear 7.5 if confirmed by credit, no new low and no bear state, else 5.5, after fear 4.5). Per stock: 5 + (score − 5) × clip(beta, 0.5, 1.5), 10% of entry timing. Holdout-tested on 2007–2016.
